guitar.evidence: "Chitlins Con Carne" is a Kenny Burrell jazz/blues guitar standard; Burrell is well known for playing Gibson hollow-body archtops (ES-335 and similar Gibson models) throughout his career.
guitar.notes: Sample title explicitly names Kenny Burrell, clarifying the actual artist despite the generic bracketed title in the artist field.

tone.target: warm jazz-blues clean with slight amp grit
tone.profile: warm jazz-blues clean with slight amp grit
tone.summary: A warm, vintage jazz-blues chain using a light boost for attack, followed by a classic Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with minimal compression, subtle distortion, and spring reverb to achieve round, articulate tones.
